page.overview:
Who is African-American Teacher?

The African-American Teacher is an unnamed teacher who works at Springfield Elementary School.

He is among the teachers who was incapable of teaching without the teacher's edition books, not even being able to remember the multiplication tables.

He is one of the teachers who express discontent and protest against Principal Skinner's miserly spending on school supplies and activities.
